sources.note: County/independent-city supplement. This is a pooled 5-year estimate, not a point-in-time2024 or2025 county value. No state shares are allocated to counties.
sources.license: U.S. federal government public information; source attribution retained.

limitations: These are native 2020–2024 ACS 5-year pooled estimates for residents age 25+, not 2025 point estimates or state 1-year values.
Cumulative attainment thresholds overlap; highest-level categories answer a different question.
Percentage intervals are not invented from component-count MOEs. Original count MOEs remain available in the county category CSV.
A locality average cannot identify an individual’s voting behavior, income, skills or preferences.
